gaps.explanation: p5 Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Cash Basis - Governmental Funds prints four major fund columns (General, Street Special Revenue, Sales Tax-Special Revenue, Debt Service) plus Non-Major Funds and Totals (p6). detail[] holds General, Street Special Revenue and Sales Tax Special Revenue (p10), the non-major combining funds (pp11-12) and Water/Sewer, but nothing for the Debt Service column, which has no schedule of its own. Debt Service column revenues: Taxes 56,797 + Intergovernmental revenues 11,845 = Total revenues 68,642 (p5). 581,659 + 68,642 = 650,301 = statement total (p6). Category of the taxes row follows the statement line already in the JSON (Property Tax 56,797, property tax).

gaps.explanation: Same Debt Service column (p5): Debt service 613 = Total expenditures 613. 407,097 + 613 = 407,710 = statement total (p6).
